_comment: Read by tools/check_drawing_bindings.py. Parameters the drawing layer (and the other view-stamping code) writes to Views, Sheets and match-line detail curves (Lines). Each must resolve, in StingTools/Data/RESOLVED_BINDINGS.csv, to that category. Change a binding through CATEGORY_BINDINGS.csv (Yes rows) or tools/param_binding_resolver.py, never by editing the generated spec.

view_receiver_allow.STING_DISPLAY_MODE: An ELEMENT parameter (tag display mode). AnnotationRunner probes it on the view with a default of 0 and nothing writes it to a view, so the probe reads the default by design. Binding it to Views would not change what any code writes.
